item.title: Biting cold paralyses daily life nationwide
item.description: An intense cold wave sweeping across Bangladesh has brought normal life to a near halt, forcing millions-especially the poor, homeless, and day labourers-into extreme hardship as temperatures plunged to their lowest levels of the season.On Friday, Jashore recorded the country's lowest temperature at just 9 degrees Celsius, while Dhaka experienced its coldest morning this winter, with the mercury dropping to 13.5 degrees Celsius, according to the Bangladesh Meteorological Department.The biting co

item.title: Veg, onion, chicken prices down; fish slightly up
item.description: The prices of winter vegetables along with onion have declined in the capital's markets due to increased supply. However, fish prices have risen slightly, while chicken prices remain stable.This scenario was observed during visits to several markets in the capital, including Karwan Bazar, on Friday.With the intensity of winter increasing in the capital, the supply of winter vegetables has also risen. item.title: Inquilab Mancha to keep Shahbagh shut until Hadi killers arrested
item.description: Inquilab Mancha has announced that it will continue the blockade at Shahbagh in Dhaka until justice is ensured in the killing of its leader Sharif Osman Hadi.On Friday, the platform's Member Secretary Abdullah Al Jaber said they would remain on the streets until all perpetrators behind the murder are arrested.Protesters gathered after Jummah prayers to begin the sit-in and continued to occupy the area through the night, demanding justice for the killing of their convener, as people from various

item.title: Ex-DU teacher passes away
item.description: Dhaka University (DU)’s retired Professor Dr Jamal Uddin Ahmed passed away early Friday.Dr Jamal Uddin Ahmed, 75, a former professor from Finance Department, died while undergoing treatment at a hospital in the capital.He left two daughters, one son, a wife, relatives, numerous students and well-wishers at the time of his death.His Namaz-e-janaza was held at DU Central Mosque, Masjidul Jamia, after Friday prayers, and he was laid to rest at Azimpur graveyard.Expressing his grief, Dhaka Universit

item.title: St Martin-bound vessel catches fire
item.description: Saint Martin-bound ship 'The Atlantic Cruise' caught fire in the Bakkhali River adjacent to the Nunia Chhara BIWTA jetty in Cox's Bazar on Saturday morning.The ship caught fire when it was heading towards Nunia Chhara BIWTA ghat in the town around 7AM, said Hossain Islam Bahadur, general secretary of St Martin's tourist vessel owners' association 'the Sea Cruise Operators Owners Association of Bangladesh'.Within moments, flames were seen spreading.There have been no reports of casualties.TF

item.title: Tarique Rahman pays tribute to Shaheed Hadi

item.title: Inqilab Moncho leaves Shahbagh to facilitate Tarique's visit
item.description: Inqilab Moncho on Saturday morning moved its blockade to near Aziz Super Market from Shahbagh intersection ahead of the visit of BNP Acting Chairman Tarique Rahman to the grave of Inqilab Moncho spokesperson Sharif Osman Hadi.The platform withdrew blockade from Shahbagh around 8:30AM and took position near Aziz Super Market.The information was shared in a Facebook post by Inqilab Moncho on Saturday.

item.title: Dhaka's flights diverted to Ctg-Kolkata-Bangkok due to poor visibility
item.description: Several international flights could not land at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport on Saturday morning due to dense fog.According to Civil Aviation Authority of Bangladesh (CAAB) officials, the flights were diverted to Chittagong, Kolkata and Bangkok as visibility dropped sharply over the capital.They said flight operations will resume as normal once weather condition improves.Passengers are being provided meals and hotel facilities from the airport authorities as required.Severe cold weathe
